newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar extend gains on wedding season buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar extend gains on wedding season buying.

text.p: India sugar prices extended gains on Wednesday on bulk buying for this month's wedding season, dealers said. Retail demand was however low.

In ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by five rupees to 1,215/1,245 rupees per quintal while M-30 climbed up by 5/10 rupees to 1,250/1,320 rupees. "Sugar mill delivery remained unquoted as most of the delivery tenders out of the free sale quota of the first half of current month were exhausted," one broker said.
Mill delivery was last quoted at 1,140/1,150 rupees per quintal.
